definitions: To be extremely frightening or horrifying.
To cause a sensation of terror or extreme fear.
examples: The ghost story was so scary, it made my hair stand on end.
The movie's special effects were so realistic, they made my hair stand on end.
The sudden noise in the dark alley made my hair stand on end.
lemma: make one's hair stand on end
synonyms: scare the living daylights out of someone
frighten someone out of their wits
source: that stuff will make your hair stand on end
